# paperclip_secret_provider_config (Resource)

Manages a Paperclip secret provider configuration ('vault') for a company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_secret_provider_config" "vault" {
  company_id    = paperclip_company.acme.id
  provider_type = "local_encrypted"
  display_name  = "Local Encrypted Store"
  is_default    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) The Paperclip company ID.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name for the secret provider configuration.
- `provider_type` (String) Provider backend type: local_encrypted, aws_secrets_manager, gcp_secret_manager, or vault.

### Optional

- `config` (String) JSON configuration parameters for the provider backend.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this provider config is the default vault for the company.
- `status` (String) Vault status: ready, warning, coming_soon, or disabled.

### Read-Only

- `health_message` (String) Health status diagnostic message reported by the secret provider backend.
- `health_status` (String) Health status reported by the secret provider backend.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the secret provider config.
